map.拖入指标生成销售、流量等 BI 报表与图表，支持筛选与汇总，用于电商经营看板，纯: Drag in metrics to generate BI reports and charts for sales, traffic and so on, with filtering and roll-up, for an e-commerce operations dashboard. Pure front-end visualisation with no backend database connection.
map.看板搭建：录入关键指标，生成日报/周报核心指标卡。: Dashboard building: enter the key metrics to generate the core metric cards for the daily and weekly report.
map.异常预警：设阈值，指标越限自动标红提示。: Abnormal alerts: set thresholds so a metric is flagged red automatically when it crosses the limit.
map.教学演示：演示同环比与占比在报表中的呈现。: Teaching demo: show how period-on-period growth and share of total appear in a report.
map.：示例：GMV 12 万、环比 +8%、毛利率 22%、退款率 4%，看板汇总成: Example: GMV 120,000, +8% period on period, gross margin 22%, refund rate 4%; the dashboard rolls these up into a business snapshot.
map.报表指标怎么选？: How do I choose the report metrics?
map.围绕目标选北极星与过程指标（流量→转化→客单→利润），避免指标过载。结果仅供电商: Pick a north star metric and process metrics around the goal (traffic → conversion → average order value → profit) to avoid metric overload. The result is for e-commerce operations estimation, product selection and decision reference only; it is not financial or tax advice and does not replace each platform's latest rules or formal reconciliation, so rely on the platform's official rules and the actual books.
map.看板按数据更新频率，经营分析多用 T+1，实时监控另需流处理。结果仅供电商运营测: Dashboards follow the data update frequency; business analysis mostly works at T+1 while real-time monitoring needs stream processing. The result is for e-commerce operations estimation, product selection and decision reference only; it is not financial or tax advice and does not replace each platform's latest rules or formal reconciliation, so rely on the platform's official rules and the actual books.
map.适度即可，过多图表分散重点；关键指标卡+趋势图最实用。结果仅供电商运营测算、选品: Moderate is enough; too many charts dilute the focus, and a key metric card plus a trend chart is the most practical. The result is for e-commerce operations estimation, product selection and decision reference only; it is not financial or tax advice and does not replace each platform's latest rules or formal reconciliation, so rely on the platform's official rules and the actual books.
